_readme: Each value carries its measured basis. A ceiling is never set above what would stay green on the measured
failure state, and never below 0.7 x that measurement. Re-measure with `node tooling/ops/check-renovate-backlog.mjs --json`.

measured.source: #417 body and its userContentEdits (26 revisions, 2026-09-03T05:42:42Z to 2026-09-22T06:01:55Z)

maxWaiting.basis: 0.7 x the 21 waiting on 2026-09-22 = 14.7, rounded up. With prHourlyLimit 6 x two runs per Monday window = 12 PRs a week against 4.4 arriving, the queue before a Monday should hold about one week of arrivals; 15 is reached only after about two Mondays that opened nothing.

maxOldestDays.basis: An update found just after a Monday window waits up to 7 days for the next one; 14 is one whole missed Monday. 0.7 x the 19.0 days the oldest entry had waited on 2026-09-22 = 13.3, so 14 is above that bound and still red on the measured state.
